Ce que Windows prend à l'ordinateur, et: What Windows takes from the computer, and when it gives it back.
La carte graphique dédiée est actuelleme: The dedicated graphics card is currently lent to Windows.
Haut-parleurs et microphone, par PipeWir: Speakers and microphone, through PipeWire. The microphone is only read when a Windows app opens it. Applies the next time Windows starts.
Les fenêtres dont Windows dessine la bar: Windows whose title bar is drawn by Windows (File Explorer, classic Notepad, dialogs…) get the desktop's title bar instead, with its rounded corners and shadow. Office, Edge and apps that draw their own bar keep theirs. Also applies to windows already open.
Windows n'installe pas les mises à jour: Windows does not install updates while you work: run Windows updates about once a month.
Réinstalle l'agent, les pilotes et les r: Reinstalls the agent, drivers and required settings (shared folders, no lock screen…) without touching your apps or files.
Installer Windows, ses pilotes et les ap: Install Windows, its drivers and apps, step by step.
Les dernières mises à jour datent de plu: The last updates are more than a month old: run Windows updates.
Délai sans fenêtre Windows au premier pl: Time with no Windows window in the foreground and no click in a Windows window. Windows wakes up immediately at the first click.
Mettre en veille sans fenêtre ouverte ap: Sleep with no window open after
Délai sans aucune application Windows ou: Time with no Windows app open. While asleep, Windows no longer uses the processor. Launching the next Windows app wakes Windows in less than a second.
Veille et arrêt seulement sur batterie: Sleep and shutdown on battery only
Sur secteur, Windows reste éveillé tant: On AC power, Windows stays awake as long as a Windows window is open.
Prêter la carte graphique dédiée à Windo: Lend the dedicated graphics card to Windows
Pour les ordinateurs à deux cartes graph: For computers with two graphics cards, when the dedicated card is free. Automatic: on mains power only. Experimental.
Cet assistant nécessite une installation: This helper requires a one-time installation with sudo.
Windows est arrêté. Windows démarre auto: Windows is stopped. Windows starts automatically when you open a Windows application.
. Appliqué au prochain démarrage de Wind: . Applied the next time Windows starts.
En veille : Windows sort automatiquement: Asleep: Windows wakes up automatically on the first click in a Windows window.
Pilote d'écran maison : Windows compose: Vasistas display driver: Windows composes its frames at the pace of a real 60 Hz screen. Takes effect the next time Windows starts.
Les applications Windows ouvertes seront: Open Windows apps will be closed. Save your documents before restarting.
Le pilote maison n'est pas posé dans ce: The Vasistas driver is not installed in this Windows: this setting has no effect.
Délai avant que Windows se mette en veil: How long before Windows sleeps when you are not using it. It wakes up on the first click. Details are in the Advanced tab.
Windows se réveille toutes les milliseco: Windows wakes up every millisecond instead of every 15.6 ms: smoother frames, slightly higher power consumption. Takes effect immediately.
Délai entre deux captures d'une fenêtre: Delay between two captures of a window hidden behind another. Follow power level: 1 s in Power saver, 500 ms in Balanced, 250 ms in Performance.
Vulkan dessine plus vite sur la carte AM: Vulkan draws faster on the AMD GPU; OpenGL if the display is unstable. Takes effect the next time Vasistas starts.
Réglages personnalisés dans l'onglet Ava: Custom settings in the Advanced tab. Move the slider to go back to a ready-made setting.
